excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin. Wears a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, white skirt and light blue pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 uses a fine air-abrasive pen tool under a bright lab lamp to clean creamy white lithographic limestone matrix from a perfectly flat Plesiosaurus skeleton. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
